title: RTP Reset Lite
description: For pvp or any server that has rtp, unsaves all changes made to terrain once that player has left the area
body:
# RTP Reset Lite **A lightweight RTP chunk reset plugin for keeping random teleport areas clean.**
--- ## What is RTP Reset Lite? RTP Reset Lite helps keep RTP areas cleaner by automatically restoring changed chunks after they unload. It is made for servers that use random teleport systems and want a simple way to prevent RTP locations from being permanently destroyed, griefed, mined out, or left messy. and works well for cpvp practice servers. This plugin is intentionally simple, lightweight, and easy to use. Discord: [https://discord.gg/A2Nx9kxDeB](https://discord.gg/A2Nx9kxDeB) Full version of the plugin at: [RTP Reset](https://builtbybit.com/resources/rtp-reset.101578/) --- ## Features - Automatically resets changed RTP chunks - Helps keep random teleport areas clean - Lightweight design - Simple enable / disable control - World blacklist support - Config reload command - Status command - Paper 1.21+ support - Works well for survival, SMP, lifesteal, factions, and general multiplayer servers --- ## Why use it? Random teleport areas can get destroyed fast. Players mine trees, break blocks, dig holes, leave floating blocks, grief terrain, or make the area look messy. Over time, RTP locations become ugly and unusable. RTP Reset Lite helps fix that by restoring changed chunks after they unload, keeping RTP zones cleaner without needing a huge rollback plugin. --- --- ## Commands | Command | Description | |---|---| | `/rtpresetlite` | Shows plugin help | | `/rtpresetlite status` | Shows current plugin status | | `/rtpresetlite reload` | Reloads the config | | `/rtpresetlite on` | Enables chunk resetting | | `/rtpresetlite off` | Disables chunk resetting | --- ## Permissions | Permission | Description | |---|---| | `rtpresetlite.admin` | Allows access to RTP Reset Lite commands | --- ## Configuration The config is simple and easy to edit.
